reading: A hero section: a plain nav row, a giant gradient-filled 'CUT' headline, a layered collage of two angled color-block 'photo' shapes with a multiply-blend blue disc and two translucent yellow tape strips crossing them, a paragraph of body copy with a small yellow button, a pink outline date-badge circle, a dark pill 'Get a table' button, and a wide-spaced all-caps footer/venue line at the page bottom.
